finding: Build001 required a kernel high framebuffer alias although the intended native bridge disables paging. The host harness mirrored that wrong address. It is not admitted for hardware.
resolution: Keep transaction.c/build001/cpu001/cpu002 intact. transaction002.c and new build002/cpu003 require physical framebuffer pointer after paging-off.
source_change: Only pointer admission changed; complete new CPU suite required.
